integrity: Analytic proof supported by exact finite verification code; priority remains subject to wider historical audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nearest-neighbour clockwise probability 1/2<p<1; no joint weak-drift limit, no finite-size convergence rates, and no independent validation. Prior geometric terminal marginal and classic hitting-time CLT are credited, not claimed novel.
title: Pathwise stabilization and independent Gaussian–geometric limits for biased cycle coverage
